result.stdout:
Eternet Release Planner

Usage:
  eternet-release-planner plan --source-directory <path> --project-list <path> --plan-output <path> --manifest-output <path> --generated-targets <path> --scope <changed|all> [options]
    --package-ids <id,id> selects only those packages and their internal dependency closure.
    --expected-source-commit <sha> rejects a checkout other than the reviewed commit.
  eternet-release-planner validate-dependency-closure --source-directory <path> --artifacts-directory <path> [--feed-base-url <url>] [--skip-feed-check]
  eternet-release-planner push-waves --plan <path> --artifacts-directory <path> --feed-url <url> --api-key <key>
  eternet-release-planner write-tag-message --plan <path> --manifest <path> --output <path> --tag-name <name>
  eternet-release-planner exchange-nuget-oidc --nuget-user <user> [--token-service-url <url>] [--audience <audience>]
